argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='E:\WebAIBridge'; $git=((& git.exe -C $root rev-parse HEAD)|Out-String).Trim(); $branch=((& git.exe -C $root branch --show-current)|Out-String).Trim(); $dirty=@(& git.exe -C $root status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=no); $h=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/health' -TimeoutSec 8; $o=$h.components.git_baseline; Write-Output ('HEAD='+$git); Write-Output ('BRANCH='+$branch); Write-Output ('DIRTY_TRACKED='+$dirty.Count); Write-Output ('HEALTH='+$h.state); Write-Output ('REASONS='+(@($h.reasons) -join ',')); Write-Output ('GIT_PROBE_STATE='+$o.state); Write-Output ('GIT_PROBE_REASON='+$o.reason); Write-Output ('GIT_PROBE_LASTSTART='+$o.lastStartedAt); Write-Output ('GIT_PROBE_LASTCOMPLETED='+$o.lastCompletedAt); Write-Output ('GIT_PROBE_LASTSUCCESS='+$o.lastSuccessAt); Write-Output ('GIT_PROBE_FAILURES='+$o.consecutiveFailures); Write-Output ('GIT_PROBE_AGE_MS='+$o.ageMs); Write-Output ('HEALTH_EVENTLOOP='+$h.eventLoop.state); Write-Output ('HEALTH_COMPONENT_COUNT='+@($h.components.PSObject.Properties).Count); Write-Output ('SERVER_HASH='+(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'app\server.js') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)
